data.loadout_text:
# Built-in loadout: fix-claude-code. The fix loadout with the Claude Code CLI
# as its writer: the same required check, the same review by a different
# model for up to three rounds, the same ADJUDICATIONS, in the same egress,
# hardened Session. The writer is the pinned Claude Code from the
# claude-code recipe image (`axocoatl recipe build claude-code`), whose
# OAuth token `axocoatl connect claude-code` stores as claude-code-oauth; the
# route Axocoatl adds sends it to api.anthropic.com, and the container holds
# a placeholder. Claude Code brings its own tools, so the writer lists none.
#
# writer_model defaults to anthropic:sonnet, an alias Claude Code 2.1.292
# resolves to claude-sonnet-5-5 (its bundled model catalog). The reviewer
# has no default: it is a native Agent on another model (Ollama or
# OpenRouter), and a reviewer on the writer's model is warned about.
#
# Budgets. Admission refuses a writer whose tokens cannot hold one model call
# of its model: Claude Code can fill a 1M-token model's whole window in one
# call, so the floor is 1,000,000 for sonnet, opus, fable and best (200,000
# for haiku). Claude Code reports every input token of every request it
# makes, cached context included, and a session re-reads its context on
# each request, so one program run can report several million tokens. A
# program run that reports more tokens than its grant still allows fails, so
# tokens leaves room for the first run and the two revisions three review
# rounds can ask for. The spending stop is cost_usd: Claude Code runs with
# --max-budget-usd at what the grant still allows, and settles to the cost it
# reports. The reviewer's budget is fix's.
schema: axocoatl.loadout/1
id: fix-claude-code
version: 1
name: Fix with Claude Code
description: >-
  The Claude Code CLI makes the change inside the Session; the host runs the
  required checks on the exact final files and a reviewer on a different
  model must approve the result.
kind: fix
params:
  writer_model:
    kind: model
    default: anthropic:sonnet
    description: anthropic:<model or alias> that Claude Code runs (default anthropic:sonnet)
  reviewer_model:
    kind: model
    required: true
    description: provider:model of the reviewer, a native Agent on Ollama or OpenRouter (use a different model than the writer)
agents:
  - id: writer
    role: writer
    runtime: claude-code
    model: { param: writer_model }
    instructions: >-
      You own this change. Find the relevant code and tests, make the change,
      run the project's check command and fix failures, then compare your diff
      with the task. When the host sends you review findings, answer every
      finding in an ADJUDICATIONS block: a line ADJUDICATIONS, then a fenced
      JSON array with one object per finding, {"id": "F1", "decision":
      "accept" or "reject", "reason": "..."}. Reject only with a concrete
      reason (the code that shows the finding is wrong). Fix each finding you
      accept, run the checks again, and give your final answer. Leave no file
      you created only for testing or debugging (scratch scripts, test binaries
      such as `go test -c` output, build outputs, reports): delete them, then
      run the project's check command one last time before your final answer.
checks:
  - name: tests
    run: { detected: true }
    timeout: 3m
review:
  model: { param: reviewer_model }
  rounds: 3
  tools: [read_file, list_dir, grep, glob]
  adjudicate: true
  instructions: >-
    Review the change against the task and against every contract and edge
    case the docs, comments and tests describe. Read the code the change
    touches, not only the diff. Number each finding F1, F2, ... at the start
    of its line, with file:line, what is wrong and what to change; report
    only defects, not style. Give the verdict line the host asks for,
    VERDICT: APPROVE or VERDICT: CHANGES. Change nothing.
budgets:
  agent: { activations: 4, invocations: 400, tokens: 20000000, cost_usd: 10 }
  reviewer: { activations: 3, invocations: 120, tokens: 1500000, cost_usd: 3 }
  wall_clock: 60m
prompt: |
  {task}
sandbox:
  network: egress
  workload: hardened
environment:
  recipes: [claude-code]
